name: 5th Avenue
biography_html: Just in time for the 35th anniversary of W:O:A, we are celebrating the 10th show of one of the first and most loyal bands on the Holy Ground: 5TH AVENUE are coming to Wacken in 2026! The cult rockers from Hamburg will be performing the highlights of their discography, which dates back to the 90s. But even in recent years, Oliver Peters and co. have been as active as ever and have proven with ‘Machine Gun’ and ‘All The Leaves Are Falling’ that their story is far from over. All the more: a night-time stroll along North Germany's 5th Avenue has rarely been so entertaining, exciting and authentic.

name: 9mm Headshot
biography_html:
They’re back — and properly so.

With „Sex, Bier & Assi-Rock“, 9mm Headshot aren’t just bringing a brand-new album to the Holy Ground. They’re delivering a manifesto cast in Metal that perfectly sums up the German four-piece: provocative lyrics and uncompromising Rock’n’Roll. The time has come for their return to W:O:A.

name: Ad Infinitum
biography_html: AD INFINITUM ist eine Band, mit der man bis ins Unendliche der symphonischen Metal-Welt und darüber hinaus gehen kann. Dass das bestens funktioniert, haben die vier Schweizer um Sängerin Melissa Bonny bereits 2023 auf dem W:O:A bewiesen und kehren zum Festivaljubiläum zurück auf den Holy Ground. Mit den Highlights ihrer ersten drei Alben „Chapter I, II, III“ und dem aktuellen Longplayer „Abyss“ präsentieren sie die perfekte Zusammenstellung für eine bombastische Show irgendwo zwischen Growls und Klargesang, harten Riffs und orchestralen Eskapaden, sowie verwunschener Märchenstunde und ungeschönter Realität.

name: Airbourne
biography_html:
We are throwing the party of the year every summer, and who cannot be missed? That's right – the good-vibes crew who bring not only hard-hitting rock ’n’ roll but also the right attitude and serious drinking stamina.
Of course, we're talking about Australia's finest, the O’Keeffe brothers – Airbourne! For 22 years, the band has basically been a part of the continent’s cultural heritage and has embraced the virtues of raspy vocals and pure fight riffs – long represented only by AC/DC and Rose Tattoo – better than almost anyone else. Welcome back to the Holy Ground.

name: Alcest
biography_html: Picture someone dumping a cloud of shoegaze fog straight into a black‑metal blizzard right in the middle of the muddy Wacken field. That’s basically Alcest. Neige’s project has been crafting shimmering walls of sound where blast beats meet guitar lines that glow like northern lights. With “Les Chants de l’aurore” they bring that dreamy storm to Wacken. Don’t be surprised if the circle pit pauses for a second… just to spin even harder.

name: Alestorm
biography_html:
Some bands write anthems – Alestorm write curses soaked in rum.
They pour Speed Folk, Power Metal, and lunacy into one boiling cauldron and grin when it spills. “Seventh Rum of a Seventh Rum” isn’t an album, it’s a drinking oath. Between keytar assaults and shanty choirs hides a pirate heart with a punk sneer. Their shows aren’t gigs, they’re storms that know rhythm. If you see them sober, you missed the point.

name: Alfahanne
biography_html:
Some things just go perfectly together: beer and barbecue, Holger and Thomas, W:O:A and you!

And then there are those connections that are just a little extra special — like the pitch-black fusion of Rock ’n’ Roll and Black Metal that Alfahanne unleash on stage. As tradition demands, this five-piece hails from Sweden, effortlessly blending the signature sounds of that region’s heaviest styles. A feast for the senses — especially your ears!

name: Alien Ant Farm
biography_html: Alien Ant Farm prove that sometimes all you need is a killer rock groove and a chorus that sticks like duct tape. Sure, everybody knows the “Smooth Criminal” cover. But live the Californians bring way more than nostalgia: crunchy riffs, sing‑along hooks and the kind of bounce that wakes up even the sleepiest Wacken crowd.

name: Alien Rockin Explosion
biography_html: The Holy Ground is about to be visited by extraterrestrials once again. Don’t worry though — these aliens arrive in peace and with a whole lot of good vibes. As longtime members of Maschine’s Late Night Show, the Spanish Rock’n’Roll invaders will take us on a trip to another galaxy.

name: Allt
biography_html:
For every true Wackener, it’s crystal clear – music is what connects us all. There’s hardly anything we value more. Allt from Sweden share this belief and not just because of their name. They fit perfectly into the next mosh pit.
A strong-willed blend of djent, metalcore, and progressive elements meets dystopian storytelling in Allt’s music, creating a unique sonic identity. This five-piece will definitely be a valuable addition to the history books of the Holy Ground – a Wacken debut you should keep an eye on.

name: Anaal Nathrakh
biography_html:
Anaal nathrakh, urthvas bethad, dokhjel djenve.

Speak this incantation on a dark night, precisely at 3 a.m., the witching hour, and perhaps a band from Birmingham will appear in your room.

The invocation borrowed from the movie Excalibur is the namesake of the British Extreme Metal veterans Anaal Nathrakh, who will seize you with their dark riffs and gripping sounds.

Do you dare? Then join our ritual!

name: Angelus Apatrida
biography_html:
The homeless angels return to the warm embrace of the Holy Ground!

After six long years away, Spain’s demolition crew is back at Wacken – toolbox packed with everything that makes the place shake.

With over 25 years of experience, the four Thrashers from Albacete know exactly how to brick you in with razor-sharp riffs – just so you can mosh your way back out moments later.

Even the Wacken Chamber of Industry and Commerce gives the thumbs up!

name: Animals as Leaders
biography_html: When Animals As Leaders start playing, guitar class suddenly turns into a sci‑fi movie. Tosin Abasi slices rhythms apart, rebuilds them and sprinkles djent grooves on top. Eight strings, no singer, riffs flying in every direction. Your brain tries to count the beats… your neck just gives up and starts headbanging.

name: Any given Day
biography_html:
The Ruhr area practically offers originals on every corner. Gelsenkirchen alone can boast a figure like Rudi Assauer, literally papal in a stature. But musically, the city also has some serious legendary potential in its back pocket.
Any Given Day can rightfully call themselves a trailblazing German Metalcore band. The group, led by frontman berserker Dennis Diehl, combines the brutality of death metal with the energy and catchiness of metalcore. The fact that, in their thirteenth year, the band can finally announce their appearance on the Holy Ground just proves: legends don’t rely on luck. They simply show up at the right time in the right place.

name: Arch Enemy
subtitle: 10th time at Wacken Open Air
biography_html:
Wenn Präzision eine Religion wäre, wären Arch Enemy die Hohepriester.
 “Deceivers” zieht Linien aus Wut, Kontrolle und süßer Gewalt.
 Gitarren kreisen wie Messer, Drums arbeiten wie Maschinen im Blutrausch.
 Zwischen Perfektion und Chaos finden sie ihren Frieden.
 Und wer Arch Enemy live erlebt, weiß: Erlösung flüstert nie – sie schreit.

name: Arroganz
biography_html: Across a vast wasteland, a glowing river of merciless lava pours down the mountains into a bottomless vortex. What the cover of Arroganz’s new album Death Doom Punks describes is also the perfect metaphor for their sound and stage show. The demolition squad from Cottbus, led by a master of black magic, has been enchanting the Extreme Metal scene for almost two decades — and now they’re ready to unleash their wicked craft on the Holy Ground.

name: Asrock
biography_html:
More local heroes than this? Impossible.

Asrock from Itzehoe are entering their 14th year as a band with one simple motto: A life for noise. And the five North Germans take that mantra seriously. Not for the first time — and certainly not for the last — they’ll heat things up on the Holy Ground.

name: Battlecreek
biography_html: Their sound reminds us of international acts such as Testament and Exodus, with whom they already shared a stage, yet they come from tranquil Bavaria. BATTLECREEK have been on the road for over 20 years and still share the same enthusiasm for playing in 2026 as they did in their early days. It's no coincidence that the band's line-up has remained so consistent and their discography is outstanding without exception. For their first W:O:A show, the Metalheads around singer Berne are preparing the next massive punch – your neck will thank you for it!

name: Bear McCreary
biography_html: What connects Terminator, Metal and the Emmy Awards? They find their creative common denominator in Bear McCreary. The award-winning soundtrack composer brings his musical magic to the W:O:A stages and proves that with his album ‘The Singularity’ his heart not only beats for symphonic sounds but also for hard tones. What began last year as part of his ‘Themes & Variations’ tour will be masterfully continued on the Holy Ground.

name: Blaas of Glory
biography_html: Eyes and ears open! Soon, BLAAS OF GLORY will be marching across the Holy Ground again with sexy snow leopard leggings, wild wigs and lots of good cheer. The Dutch party animals with their guitars, accordion, timpani, clarinet, tuba and percussion instruments are a perfect fit for our anniversary motto. When the drum major and his crew transform Alice Cooper into a waltz, KISS into country and Van Halen into rumba, you know what that means: Party on!

name: Black Label Society
biography_html:
Zakk Wylde wears his heart like a weapon – open, heavy, sincere.
Black Label Society is whiskey, sweat, and prayer tuned to drop-C.
“Doom Crew Inc.” breathes blues-soaked fury with embers of hope beneath.
Every note sounds like dirt, every chorus like redemption.
This is music for those who’ve learned to fall and still stand tall.
Because pain was always part of the chord.

name: Black Tish
biography_html: They have been named the missing link between “Einstürzende Neubauten” and bands like “Nine Inch Nails” or “Ministry”. Black Tish, formed in Belgium in 1988, released their debut in 2023 and are now ready to show the world what they’re made of. In 2026 they will visit us again!

name: Bleed From Within
biography_html:
From Glasgow’s rain and concrete comes their metallic heartbeat.
Bleed From Within don’t play – they construct walls of sound.
“Shrine” was a prayer made of sweat, precision, and revolt.
They balance fury and form with surgical grace.
Every song feels engineered, bolted with fire.
And when the breakdown hits, the world goes with it.

name: Blood Command
biography_html:
RoboCop, Commando, Red Dawn, Blood Command. This list sounds like the return slip from your local video store, waiting for you to bring back those VHS tapes you've had for over 25 years. But one intruder has snuck in. Blood Command make no secret of their love for cheesy 80s Horror movie titles. They mix that flair with fast-paced Hardcore Punk and a whole lot of charisma.
It’s a recipe that’s been working for over 17 years – so why change something that already works so well? Welcome to the Holy Ground!

name: Blood Fire Death
subtitle: A tribute to Bathory / Germany exclusive
biography_html:
Honor to whom honor is due! 22 years after the death of the legend, another dazzling figure from the Scandinavian Black Metal scene takes up the torch of blazing hellfire that Quorthon once ignited – and makes the flames rise anew.
With Blood Fire Death, Watain high priest Erik Danielsson pays tribute to the creator of the eerie and the dark, giving Bathory the monument they’ve always deserved. Between Viking and Black Metal, Bathory has carved itself deeply into the history books of heavy metal. An absolute must for every Metal fan! They are riding to Wacken for one exclusive German Show – we cannot contain our excitement!

name: Blood Red Throne
subtitle: "Altered Genesis" Set
biography_html: Be there when the gates of hell open once again and Blood Red Throne claim their rightful place. After their first appearance on our holy ground more than ten years ago, the five Death Metal heavyweights return to Wacken to spread fear and terror while they perform a special Altered Genesis set. While you’re still being sucked into the pit, your face twisted in horror, the Norwegians will bombard you with their serenades of horror, murder, and mayhem. Simply glorious, isn’t it?

name: Broken By The Scream
biography_html: Don’t judge a book by its cover! The Japanese idol group is making the journey to Wacken and is ready to tear you apart – all while looking like total pros. Their mix of crushing metalcore and anime-style cuteness feels like a newly invented symbiosis between Hello Kitty and a bulldozer. No one is too tough for Kawaii – and Broken by the Scream are here to prove it to you.

name: Brunhilde
biography_html: The four musicians from Fürth are as powerful and determined as the eponymous heroine from the Nibelungen saga. BRUNHILDE released their fifth album ‘In Love Your's Hate’ on their own label in the middle of the year, in which they tell of love and hate and the bitter struggle for freedom. Frontwoman Caro knows exactly how to combine the best of Punk, Hard Rock and Metal with her likeable manner – we look forward to seeing them again at W:O:A.

name: Castle Rat
biography_html:
Excuse me — latest hot shit? Found it! Somewhere between nightmare and opera lies the realm of Castle Rat.
Their doom rituals smell of incense, sweat, and legend. On stage they slay the colossal Rat Lord – over and over, louder each time.
Guitars swing like swords, vocals drip with curses. Fantasy meets darkness, every gig a boss battle. See them once, and you’re joyfully doomed forever.

name: Chaosbay
biography_html:
From the East of Germany straight to the North – Chaosbay are ready for round two on Wacken soil!

Brace yourself for neck-breaking time shifts, brutal breakdowns, and dangerously catchy choruses.

The Leipzig quartet brings along their new record Are You Afraid? and a live show that hits harder than ever.

Even after more than a decade, their sound still feels fresh – a fountain of youth, Wacken-style.

name: Corrosion of Conformity
biography_html: CORROSION OF CONFORMITY are really busy – in a positive sense. The American quartet was on tour with Judas Priest and Alice Cooper, is working on a new studio album for 2026, and Stanton Moore has recently rejoined the band as a permanent member after the band had to cope with the loss of drummer Reed Mullin. Stronger than evert they are looking ahead! Conformity? Not a chance! Pepper Keenan and his band are too versatile, ambitious and creative for that!

name: Cowgirls From Hell
biography_html:
Birmingham — cradle of Heavy Metal.

Around here, hard steel is absorbed with mother’s milk.

It’s the only explanation for legends like Ozzy, Rob Halford… and of course the Cowgirls From Hell.

Their mission? To kick your asses in the best possible way.

A DJ set by these two British women isn’t just a DJ set — it’s a full-throttle rollercoaster ride through everything that hits hard and keeps your neck spinning.

And once the Cowgirls are done with you, you’ll probably need a week in an oxygen tent. Guaranteed.

name: Craft
biography_html:
Things are about to turn pitch black and ice cold – Craft are making their way from the far north of Sweden to the far north of Germany.

They’re bringing with them hymns of frozen beauty and vocals that will make your blood run cold. If Black Metal were a drink, Craft would be everything that hits hard and comes with plenty of ice!

name: Crematory
subtitle: 35th Anniversary Show
biography_html: There's a lot going on for CREMATORY right now. Their latest studio album, ‘Destination,’ earned the band their highest chart entry to date in the German Top 10, after which the band went on tour in Germany and re-released their genre-defining catalogue, including albums such as “Illusions” and ‘Awake.’ A nod to the past and at the same time a clear step forward. The next stop is Wacken, where the Gothic Metal pioneers will perform their dark songs for the ninth time. What a kick off the celebrations for the band's 35th anniversary.

name: Crimson Glory
biography_html: Crimson Glory sound like dreams cast in chrome. Their “Transcendence” remains a masterclass in drama, pathos, and precision. Masks, myths, melodies – flirting with the divine but grounded in grit. Every note a prayer to the cosmos, every solo a crack in the sky. They are melancholy with a crown, theatre with backbone. And those who get it, hear not music – but magnitude.

name: Cruachan
biography_html: When the Holy Ground turns into a battlefield, chances are Cruachan are not far away. For over 30 years the Irish Folk Metal veterans have called Metalheads to arms — and to their mead horns. Because if you earn your spurs in the pit, you’ve also earned the right to enjoy the gentler Celtic tones afterwards.

name: Crypt Sermon
biography_html: A mighty cross, spider webs and a skull adorn the backdrop of CRYPT SERMON. No wonder, because the US band led by singer Brooks Wilson plays Epic Doom Metal and preaches dark stories and enchanted legends in sometimes overly long songs. On Wasted Wednesday, they bring the dark atmosphere to the Holy Ground. Tune your airguitars down a tone and give the slow, raw sound its space – Stage clear for CRYPT SERMON.

name: Cursed Abyss
subtitle: Founded at Wacken Music Camp
biography_html: Metal brings people together — and sometimes even brings them straight to Wacken. Cursed Abyss are the perfect example: the brutal Hamburg five-piece actually formed at the Wacken Music Camp in 2022. Now they return to that very same field to unleash their latest album Rot In Existence. If anyone ever asks you what Wacken sounds like — this is it.

name: Danko Jones
biography_html: With their brand new album ‘Leo Rising’, Canadian rockers DANKO JONES have raised the bar once again and proven that they are still going strong almost two decades after the band was formed. It's no surprise that the trio has already been nominated for the Juno Awards (the Canadian Grammy Awards) and has gathered a loyal fan base around the world. Raise your horns: It's going to be a Punk, Metal and Blues thunderstorm on the Holy Ground.

name: Deafheaven
biography_html: Deafheaven sound like a black‑metal thunderstorm crashing through a wall of shoegaze haze. Blast beats, huge guitars and that strange mix of chaos and beauty. Their songs can feel like lightning and sunshine at the same time. On the Wacken stage that turns into a full‑on weather system.

name: Def Leppard
biography_html:
Who’s got the hairspray? You’ll definitely need more of it for W:O:A 2026 if you want to match the style of these legends: Def Leppard are gracing the Holy Ground! Formed in 1977 in Sheffield, England, they rose from the New Wave of British Heavy Metal in the ‘80s to become a global Rock phenomenon – and to this day, they’re considered icons of Melodic Hardrock. With albums like Pyromania (1983) and the diamond-certified Hysteria (1987), they perfected the blend of hard riffs and Pop charm. They’ve shown resilience – even in the face of setbacks – and remain veterans of an era many still long for.

When Def Leppard take the stage, it feels like we’re back in the ’80s – hair high, leggings tight, and sugar on the go.

name: Diabolisches Werk
biography_html: The devil's work began a few years ago with a blood-stained logo, dark thoughts and a healthy dose of thundering Death Metal riffs. Today, we are seizing the opportunity to announce DIABOLISCHES WERK for Wasted Wednesday. See for yourself what this quartet from Kiel is capable of as they knock your senses out and draw you to the dark side with their sharpened scythe.

name: Dieter "Maschine" Birr
biography_html: For many East German Metalheads, the name “Maschine” is impossible to avoid. As the frontman of the legendary Puhdys, he was part of every respectable Amiga record collection. But Western fans know Dieter “Maschine” Birr as well. The legend has been touring solo for years — and Wacken wouldn’t be Wacken if this poet of loud and quiet moments didn’t step onto the Holy Ground. Legendary stuff — or as Doro would say: When East meets West…

name: Dirty Shirt
biography_html:
A stain on your shirt? Annoying.

Dirty Shirt at W:O:A? Absolutely perfect.

The Romanian band has been around for nearly 30 years and remains one of the hottest musical exports from the country. Their wild mix of heavy styles earned them second place at the Wacken Metal Battle 2014. Time to return to the Holy Ground.

name: Divlje Jagode
biography_html:
If any band deserves the title living witnesses of (Rock) history, it’s Divlje Jagode.

Led by almost-Whitesnake-guitarist Zele Lipovača, these Bosnian Hard Rock veterans have been celebrating the spirit of Rock ’N’ Roll for over 40 years – no matter how wild the world around them spun.

Tito, the fall of Yugoslavia, the Balkan War – none of it could stop Divlje Jagode.

And in 2026, they’ll stand on the Wacken stage for the very first time – just one year before their 50th (!) anniversary.

Welcome to Wacken, legends!

name: Dritte Wahl
biography_html:
Dritte Wahl aren’t nostalgia – they’re the kick in the present tense.
Their Punk has aged, but never tamed.
Lyrics that bleed without whining, choruses that know more than they shout.
Proof that conviction outshouts distortion.
Every stage becomes a street corner, every crowd a movement.
Punk with spine – because silence is always the worse choice.

name: Dubioza Kolektiv
biography_html: Life is fun – and we want to celebrate that with you at W:O:A! Reason enough to welcome the Dub band DUBIOZA KOLEKTIV from Bosnia and Herzegovina as the mood makers. Percussion, accordion, guitar and lots of good vibes will get you dancing. Even more than 20 years after the release of their self-titled debut album, their mix of Punk, Ska, Rock and many other styles is still full of energy and shows that the Balkans are a perfect fit for Wacken.

name: E.N.D.
subtitle: Metal Battle Balkan Regions
biography_html:
E.N.D. (Evil Never Dies) is a tech-groove metal/hardcore band from Zadar, Croatia. Formed in 1996, they're one of the longest-running and most steadfast names in the Croatian metal underground — celebrating 30 years of activity at Wacken Open Air 2026.

Built around brothers Alen and Davor Babin, the band has played hundreds of shows and supported the likes of Testament, Decapitated, The Ocean, Municipal Waste, God Dethroned, Negură Bunget, and Xentrix. Veterans of Brutal Assault, Metalcamp, Euroblast, and Monte Paradiso, E.N.D. arrive at Wacken with a surprise: a four-piece "two-bass attack" lineup that secured their slot. If you're into Meshuggah, Bury Your Dead, The Haunted, or After The Burial — don't miss this.

name: Einherjer
biography_html:
What Valhalla is to Vikings, the Holy Ground is to us metalheads. And for some, the two even go hand in hand. Einherjer are something like the patron saints of all those who both honor the Holy Ground and long for entry into Valhalla. Musically somewhere between Folk, Metal, and a certain vocal extravagance, the band has been on a grand journey since 2004.

And who knows – maybe the Holy Ground is what they’ve been searching for all along: Valhalla!

name: Eläkeläiset
biography_html: Wenn ihr Eläkeläiset fünf Mal schnell hintereinander sagen könnt, erscheint euch heute Nacht der Humppa Gott und nimmt euch mit auf eine Reise in die Tiefen des Offbeats und der Akkordeons. Oder ihr habt einfach Tickets für das W:O:A 2026 und könnt den finnischen Großmeistern höchstselbst bei der Arbeit zusehen. Wer diesen Titel ernsthaft in Frage stellen möchte, möge uns bitte vorlegen, welche Band sonst einen ähnlichen Kultstatus in Hacker-Kreisen genießt und es seit Mitte der 1990er Jahre geschafft hat kontinuierlich den heiligen Acker zu besuchen. Wir warten dann mal.

name: Electric Bassboy
subtitle: Sideproject Electric Callboy
biography_html:
Electric Bassboy is the electronic troublemaker born from Electric Callboy —
 the project where they ditch the guitars, twist the knobs, and crank the bass so hard even seasoned metalheads start wondering whether to headbang or simply hold on.

Hardstyle, rave, full-throttle chaos — delivered at a pace that makes the circle pit question its life choices.
 Electric Bassboy doesn’t show up to play a polite DJ set;
 he shows up to prove what pure, unfiltered mayhem sounds like without a single guitar involved.

Loud. Ridiculous. Absolutely legendary.

name: Elvicho
biography_html:
ELCHIVO is a stoner rock and doom metal band from Monterrey, Mexico, formed in 2018. Founded by Marco Gil (originally of Maligno), the lineup is rounded out by Stefan Berdem (drums), Viin Angelini (vocals), and Roi Zerda (guitars).

Their 2020 self-titled debut LP earned national recognition, including nominations for Stoner Rock Album of the Year and New Band of the Year. The band now returns with their new album Under the Black Sun — nine tracks exploring new sounds and textures while keeping the essence that defines them. The first single, "The Unforeseen", is out now, with festival dates in Mexico and beyond on the horizon.

name: Emperor
subtitle: Best-of + Emperor EP Set
biography_html:
Bow down, mortals – Emperor will rise again to unleash a monumental Black Metal ritual at Wacken!

For one night only, they will summon the darkness - beyond and array of their full works specially concentration on their self-titled debut EP.

This will not be just a show. It’s a black mass, a tribute to the record that changed the face of Extreme Metal forever.

And it gets darker… The legendary original lineup is reforged.

Wacken will never be the same.

Come witness history, darkness, and triumph –

The night belongs to the trve.

name: Employed To Serve
biography_html: When they rocked the Holy Ground in 2023, one thing was certain: We'll see each other again soon. EMPLOYED TO SERVE are coming to the anniversary edition of W:O:A with their new album ‘Fallen Star’ in tow. Fans of Metalcore, Post-Hardcore and Mathcore will get their money's worth! If you want to prepare yourself, you can listen to the current single ‘Atonement’, which was recorded together with Lorna Shore singer Will Ramos.

name: Europe
biography_html: It took only one song to catapult the next band into the hall of fame: “The Final Countdown.” Founded in 1979 in Sweden, Europe has far more to offer than just that one synth riff. Joey Tempest’s voice remains unchanged to this day, as if preserved in a time capsule. Europe delivers stadium-worthy performances that you’ll remember – and want – for a long time to come! Now the giants are landing at Wacken, and we can’t wait to roar along with them to all their famous songs!

name: Evil Jared & Krogi
biography_html: When Evil Jared & Krogi show up, expect everything except a normal concert. Punk spirit, rock groove and pure WTF-chaos collide. Crowd antics, random madness, things getting weird in the best possible way. Basically the kind of beautiful mayhem a festival like Wacken was built for.

name: Expellow
subtitle: Metal Battle Winner 2025
biography_html: Sometimes they come back — and in the case of Expellow, they do so quickly. The winners of last year’s Wacken Metal Battle will storm the Holy Ground again in 2026. The Swiss Metalcore machine around frontwoman Mik Dean knows the field inside and out — and will once again put their well-oiled brutality engine at the disposal of every pit enthusiast. Oh, and they’re celebrating their 20th anniversary. Sounds like a proper party, right?

name: Faun
biography_html: Once again, The Holy Land opens its gates for passionate storytellers, glorious jesters, and fantastic epics of all kinds. No surprise that Faun feel right at home here. The Munich-based pagan rock group stands for captivating and elegant storytelling and has been the go-to source for atmospheric journeys into realms and eras beyond our imagination for 26 years. Welcome back to the Holy Ground!

name: Finsterforst
biography_html: They sing about mystical creatures, nature and its destruction by humans. Their music is dark, with Folk elements mixed in and it's no surprise that FINSTERFORST hail from the gloomy Black Forest. Their unique blend of Pagan, Post and Black Metal with epic orchestral parts and powerful choirs has made the band a fixture on the scene, and we can't wait to welcome the Black Forest metallers to the Holy Ground for the second time.

name: Firespawn
subtitle: In Memory Of LG Petrov
biography_html: Firespawn are back! Formed in 2015 as a Swedish Death Metal supergroup, the five-piece had to face a heavy loss six years later with the passing of founding member and national Death Metal legend L.G. Petrov. Now they return with a new vocalist, ready to blast us with their old-school-soaked riffs. The flames are burning fiercer than ever – just in time to celebrate our anniversary together!

name: Fit For An Autopsy
biography_html:
“Metal isn’t dangerous anymore.”

Ever catch yourself thinking that? Then you might simply be listening to the wrong bands. Fit For An Autopsy from New Jersey bring everything needed to shock your well-behaved friends: brutal sounds, progressive elements and the nastiest Deathcore steamroller you can imagine. Six guys who have been rearranging jaws for almost two decades. Now jump into the pit and prove this first sentence wrong.

name: Focus.
biography_html:
Not to be confused with the Dutch Hard Rockers of the ’70s – Focus. from Germany are kicking in the door with both feet and childlike joy on the gas pedal.

Or as they put it themselves: “Armed with words and cigarette smoke against the darkness of simple beats and empty lyrics.”

The crew from Riesa are hitting Wacken Open Air with a brand-new album and a full-speed stop on their Sternhagelvoll 2026 tour. Buckle up – this ride’s about to get wild.

name: Force
biography_html:
FORCE is a glam hard rock band from Melipilla and Santiago, Chile, founded by Laureano Starboy and Camila Sulwacker, together with bassist Hans Beyer. Their sound fuses 80s hard rock, heavy riffs, retrowave synths, and raw, classic-style vocals.

In 2025, they released their debut single "Shine Like Me, B#tch!" followed by "SPEED" — both building toward their first LP, slated for 2026. Despite being active for only six months, FORCE won over jury and crowd alike at their national heat. In 2026, the band will also serve as the official opening act for HALESTORM in Chile.

name: Future Palace
biography_html: Only a few bands today are as widely praised for their innovation in metal as Future Palace. With their 2024 album Distortion, the Berlin-based trio has firmly secured their place among the top tier of modern metal bands. After their explosive Wacken show in 2024, the band now returns to the Holy Ground with renewed energy and even more confidence — ready to turn Wacken completely upside down this time. Their modern approach and effortless shifts through the various styles of metal have long since made them more than just an insider tip.

name: Given By The Flames
subtitle: Metal Battle Japan
biography_html:
Given By The Flames is a gothic metalcore band from Tokyo, Japan. Over the years, they've shared stages with global acts and earned a reputation for emotionally intense performances that hit just as hard as they hurt.

Their sound channels raw anger, sorrow, and beauty in equal measure — soaring clean vocals colliding with crushing breakdowns — driven by a creative mission to give voice to hidden emotions, both their own and the audience's. Recent releases like the singles "NIHIL" and "UNTIL WE MEET IN HELL AGAIN", alongside their full-length album A Book of Agony (now streaming), showcase their growth while staying true to their gothic metalcore roots.

name: Grand Magus
biography_html:
Have you ever wondered what’s on the playlist of the Norse gods? We’ve got the answer: Grand Magus! 

The Stockholm-based band began their journey as a doom outfit but quickly evolved into one of the most epic heavy metal groups in Europe. Their music sweeps across the field like hymns, feeling like the soundtrack to the gods’ most legendary battles. The sound is reminiscent of a mix between Manowar, Rainbow, and Black Sabbath – yet they bring their own unmistakable style. Especially thanks to frontman JB’s voice, which sinks into your brain like a siren’s song and demands to be followed. Grand Magus is a must at Wacken – especially for those ready to march into battle.

name: Guilt Trip
biography_html:
Manchester isn’t just about football – it’s also a breeding ground for violent dancing and Hardcore devastation.

Guilt Trip prove it loud and clear.

In just ten short years, these five Mancunians have laid waste to stages across the globe with their crushing mix of Hardcore and Beatdown.

Armed with their new single Burn and a fresh deal with Roadrunner Records, another sonic assault is surely on the way.

Get ready for impact.

name: Gutalax
biography_html: The next band is a total toilet disaster — literally! And we mean that in the most positive way possible. We’re talking about Gutalax! The Czech band is gracing W:O:A and bringing a whole lot of fun with them. Since their formation in 2009, Gutalax has become infamous for their infectious live shows — where toilet paper is never in short supply. And the music? Top-tier goregrind with guttural vocals, slapstick humor, and a guaranteed dance factor! Circle pits are old news — Gutalax are coming to the Holy Ground to kick off the Toilet Pit! So, grab your toilet paper and get ready!

name: H-Blockx
biography_html: They were often dubbed the German answer to Rage Against The Machine – The talk is of H-Blockx. Quality crossover, hip-hop vibes, and arena rock. Founded in 1991 in Münster, they rose to fame with songs like “Risin’ High” and “Move.” With chunky guitar riffs, unforgettable choruses, and rap vocals, H-Blockx carved out a name for themselves. They create the soundtrack for baggy pants, skateboards, and festivals where the mud still smelled like freedom. And what place could be more perfect for that than Wacken? We say: none!

name: Hackneyed
biography_html:
Right on time for their 20th anniversary, a legendary steamroller returns to the Holy Ground!

Hackneyed are back – a full decade after calling it quits – to blast away your skulls with roaring Death Metal once more.

We’ve been waiting for this, and we’re damn ready to have our brains rattled by these icons of the German scene.

name: Hämatom
biography_html: Their paths lead in all directions, and next year the tour bus is heading to Wacken! In 2024, HÄMATOM celebrated a memorable show on the Holy Ground, did a concert-battle with rapper Finch, and still had to cope with the loss of their bassist and founding member West. We are excited to see what the loud and proud quartet prepares for next year. With their current album ‘Für Dich’ (2025), they pay tribute to West and have written plenty of new material for their set list. As always, the motto is: Join in, go wild, and if you have anything to complain about - ‘Erzähl es meinem Mittelfinger!’

name: Hardline
biography_html:
Hard Rock without wild backstories? Doesn’t exist.

But when your band’s formation at some time involved two members of Journey, you’re truly playing in a different league.

Hardline combine everything that makes the ’80s the decade of desire – with a line-up bursting with flair, melody, and groove.

Despite breakups and rebirths, the band’s fire never faded.

Time to party, old-school style!

name: Hatebreed
biography_html: What can you say about the crew led by professional throat-shredder Jamey Jasta that hasn’t already been written in the chronicles of Hardcore and Metal? Hatebreed are pure cult — and have been for ages. The sheer brutality with which these Americans stir up their groove makes concrete look like jelly. If you’ve never lost your mind to Destroy Everything, can you really say you’ve been to a Hatebreed show? Your next chance: W:O:A 2026.

name: Heartless Human Harvest
biography_html:
Boundaries exist to be tested. To walk along them — and to break them again and again. At least, if you ask us.

Luckily, we’ve found kindred spirits in Heartless Human Harvest. Somewhere between Metal and Hardcore, driven riffs and bone-shattering breakdowns, the northern German five-piece stands ready to turn the Holy Ground into their personal playground.

Be a part of the human harvest.

name: Heavysaurus
biography_html: At a first glance they are summoners of a long forgotten time. No way! Because the dinos of HEAVYSAURUS entertain the whole offspring of our loud and favourite music. Plea to all young W:O:A fans: Once the colourful primeval rockers turn on the amps, show your parents how much power you got! Pommesgabel reload!

name: I See Red
subtitle: Metal Battle Greece
biography_html:
I See Red is a melodic death metal band from Athens, Greece, formed in 2014. Their sound fuses melodic death metal with hardcore and black metal, building a dark, intense atmosphere all their own.

Following the EPs As Hope Runs Dry (2016) and A Drop of Truth (2020), the band underwent a complete lineup renewal. After an explosive support slot for the legendary The Haunted, 2026 marks I See Red's return with new material and a refreshed sound that continues to evolve their identity.

name: In Flames
biography_html: What screams "pioneers of melodic death metal" more than In Flames? With albums like The Jester Race and Clayman, they helped define the legendary “Göteburg Sound”! After their early successes, In Flames shifted stylistically toward alternative metal in the 2000s. With frontman Anders Fridén’s unmistakable voice and their signature riffs, the band has become an unshakable force in the scene — some would even say they're the leaders. They’re no strangers to the fields of Wacken either, having already delivered countless unforgettable moments on the Holy Ground. So, it should come as no surprise that they’re welcome guests at W:O:A — and we’re already looking forward to creating more memories with them.

name: Insanity Alert
biography_html: Wer hat diese Irren auf den Holy Ground gelassen? Bei Insanity Alert ist die Warnung im Namen sicherlich kein nettgemeinter Hinweis, sondern echte Warnung. Bei langanhaltender Moshpit Action angefeuert durch Heavy Kevy und seine Mitstreiter können langfristig entscheidende Nebenwirkungen auftreten. Bei so viel Spaß und guter Stimmung können wir leider nicht ausschließen, dass ihr euch umgehend in die Österreicher verlieben könntet. Ihr mit Hardcore angereicherter Thrash ist ebenfalls nichts für sanfte Gemüter. Doch die Jungs kommen nicht nur um zu shredden, sondern um Party zu machen! Sie feiern ihr 15. Jubiläum in Wacken und lasst uns euch eines sagen: Niemand hat die Kunst Party zu machen so perfektioniert wie Insanity Alert! Packt die Aspirin ein - wer sich dieser Gefahr trotzdem stellen will ist herzlich eingeladen!

name: Judas Priest
biography_html: It's time for a legend – because it's time for JUDAS PRIEST! Even after more than five decades in the music business, more than 50 million records sold and their latest LP ‘Invincible Shield’ (2024), Metal god Rob Halford and his bandmates are ready to rock Holy Ground with tons of riffs, a vocal range spanning over four octaves and roaring motorbikes. Raise your horns, oil your vocal cords and give it your all when „Breaking The Law“, „Painkiller”, „The Serpent And The King“ and many more familiar songs ring out.

name: Kadavar
biography_html: Kadavar sound like someone plugged a dusty Sabbath record into a screaming tube amp and cranked it to festival mode. Fuzz guitars, psychedelic grooves and warm vintage vibes everywhere. When the Berlin Fantastic (now) Four kicks in, the Wacken field suddenly feels like a giant 1970s rock club.

name: Kärbholz
biography_html: True to their motto ‘Vollgas Rock’n‘Roll’, German Rock quartet KÄRBHOLZ are tirelessly committed to giving their fans 100% with songs about the heart and mind and the relentless game of life. They have always been rebels, with karma on their side, and have always torn down barricades with heart and soul. The rockers have not only announced a new tour for 2026, but are also working on new music for the follow-up to their 2023 albums ‘Barrikaden’ and ‘Wilde Augen’. Grab yourself a cold beer and turn up the volume! We're looking forward to a loud party in Wacken!

name: Kim Dracula
biography_html: If Nosferatu had sailed to Tasmania instead of Wisborg and wreaked havoc there, we could explain the existence of Kim Dracula as the result of a vampire bite. Science demands we describe what we hear and see — and it’s this: Kim Dracula enchants our ears with an exotic mix of Trap, Hip-Hop, and Metal. A mad blend of styles made even more intense by the singer’s unhinged presence. A Wacken debut we’re seriously looking forward to!

name: Kittie
biography_html: Kittie are the rusted nails in Nu-Metal’s coffin — and the queens who forged it. While others sang about high school pain, they spat venom and truth. “Spit” was raw wound turned battle cry, opening a door for women in Metal. Two decades later, they sharpen the blade again — older, angrier, wiser. “Fire” sounds like a time machine crash-landing in the storm. And this time, it doesn’t burn out — it burns everything down.

name: Kupfergold
biography_html: Back in the days of the gold rush, every prospector needed their own claim. Here at Wacken, all you need is your spot on the Holy Ground to strike real gold — more precisely, Kupfergold. In their tricky seventh year, the medieval rock band finally made it to Wacken. Sometimes, you must dig a little deeper to uncover the true treasures — and now the reward is all the greater. Welcome to the Holy Ground!

name: Lacuna Coil
biography_html: LACUNA COIL have been on the road for over three decades and this year released their tenth album, ‘Sleepless Empire’. Their mix of Gothic, Alternative and Death Metal has always thrilled their loyal fan base. With current songs such as ‘Oxygen’ and ‘Hosting the Shadow’, the Italian band led by singer Cristina Scabbia shows that they are still full of energy, and who knows, maybe we'll get to hear the latter song live with guest singer Randy Blythe from Lamb of God? In any case, both bands are playing at Holy Ground. Don't miss the show!

name: Lagwagon
biography_html: Neben all den dunklen und fies dreinblickenden Gestalten braucht es manchmal auch einen Tupfer Farbe und Fröhlichkeit. Bei Lagwagon bleibt der Pit freundlich, die Mienen heiter und die Sonne draußen – kein Wunder beim ansteckenden Punk Rock der Amerikaner. Dass die Band bereits seit Beginn der 1990er Jahre mit guter Laune um sich wirft, kann hier getrost als Erfahrung verbucht werden. Und für alle, denen das jetzt zu viel good vibes war, denkt immer dran: Wo kein Licht ist, gibt es auch keinen Schatten!

name: Lamb of God
biography_html: There are bands whose very name is enough to send entire legions of metalheads into a frenzy of anticipation. Lamb of God is without question one of those bands. The U.S. powerhouse fronted by Randy Blythe has fought hard for their place in the spotlight. Tireless since the early 1990s, they’ve toured relentlessly and delivered album after album, hit after hit, to the hungry metal masses. Now, 35 years later, that spotlight is more than well-deserved. And in case anyone still hasn’t gotten the message: Lamb of God are coming to Wacken 2026!

name: Life of Agony
biography_html: All good things come in threes: after impressive W:O:A shows in 2019 and 2022, we are delighted to welcome New York based Alternative Metal band LIFE OF AGONY for the third time. Keith Caputo and his bandmates looked back on their long career during this year's UGLY tour, but also released a new song „The Crow“. Who knows, maybe we'll get to hear even more fresh music before their performance in Wacken?! However, one thing is certain: fan favorites such as ‘River Runs Red’ and ‘Weeds’ will shake the Holy Ground.

name: Lovebites
biography_html:
Tokyo 2016 – Wacken 2026.

In between: ten years of Power Metal without limits and a legendary Wacken show in 2018. Now Lovebites return to Northern Germany for their 10th anniversary, bringing epic melodies, a huge show and their new album Outstanding Power. Message received — we’re ready.

name: Luna Kills
biography_html: Asking Finland to produce iconic and innovative metal bands is about as pointless as asking Michael Jordan to win basketball titles — it’s simply in their nature. This country was born to flood our beloved genre with legendary acts. And with Luna Kills, yet another one is stepping up to the plate. With surprising ease, this quartet blends nu-metal with electronic elements. Now, in their sixth year as a band, the Finns are setting out to haunt the Holy Ground — and we can’t wait!

name: Mambo Kurt
biography_html: Few word combinations make as much sense as Mambo and Kurt. Maybe only organ and god come close. With humor, technical brilliance and a home organ, the Orgelgott has been making the Holy Ground boil for years — whether playing classics like Van Halens Jump or his immortal Wacken anthem. Mambo Kurt belongs to Wacken like our beloved weather conditions.

name: Manntra
biography_html: All good things come in threes: In 2026, MANNTRA will rock the W:O:A for the third time and present their latest songs from the album ‘Titans’. The Croatian Folk Metal quintet knows exactly how to give ancient themes a modern twist and complement raw Industrial Metal with playful Folk elements. MANNTRA fits our motto ‘Party on’ 100%, and that's exactly what we want to celebrate with you: oil your vocal cords and raise your fists in the air when ‘Ori Ori’ and other highlights ring out.

name: Mantar
biography_html: In the realm of extreme music, Mantar are neither unknown nor outliers. The band stands for the highest quality and has earned a reputation as an excellent live acting. Hailing from Bremen, these guys emerged in 2012 from the steel basins of the Hanseatic city and have shed everything that isn’t essential to their music. As uncompromising as that sounds, so does their music — no frills. Direct, brutal, and always hitting where it hurts. According to their own words, their only goal is simple: just hit hard! With that resume in hand, we warmly welcome them to W:O:A 2026.

name: Maschine's Late Night Show
biography_html:
35 editions of Wacken Open Air.

Hard to believe there was ever a time when Maschine’s Late Night Show didn’t light up the Welcome To The Jungle Stage late at night with glamour, confetti, and a whole lot of sparkle.

Our talkmaster with the legendary blow-dried hairstyle gets them all — because even the biggest stars of heavy entertainment eventually want a spot on his couch.

And we already know you love him anyway.

Because who loves you — and who do you love?

Maschine!

name: Metaklapa
biography_html:
Six guys, six voices, one passion – Metal! Croatia brings us their very own Heavy Metal Acapella band to the Holy Ground, again!

Between Fear of the dark, Wasted years and other Maiden classics stands a group of men, that present our beloved classics in a very distinctive style, that is even listed at the UNESCO heritage list. Let’s start our very own Wacken moshpit to welcome these trule one of a kind band to our festival once again!

name: Midhaven
subtitle: Metal Battle India
biography_html: Midhaven is a four-piece progressive metal band from Mumbai, India. Striving to bring a distinct 'Indic' voice to the world of heavy music, the band's strength was born from a confluence of Western heaviness blended with Indian Ragas — crafting evergreen, earth-shattering art with every release.

name: Minotaurus
biography_html:
Epic medieval stories wrapped in authentic sound?

Say no more: Minotaurus.

Since 1994 the band from Aschaffenburg has been honoring the spirit of Folk and Metal. With their latest album Memories In The Haze, they invite us once again into their fantastic world.

name: Misery Index
biography_html:
The year 2026 brings us a quarter century of Misery Index — twenty-five years of top-tier blasting fury. That alone is reason to celebrate, as the band returns to the far north for the first time in over two decades.

Their Death Metal infused with Hardcore elements is the perfect event for those who like it brutally hard and without unnecessary frills. Party On!

name: Misþyrming & Nergal
subtitle: Perform Behemoth's "Sventevith" Storming Near The Baltic
biography_html:
When the dark lord speaks to his followers, they listen in reverent silence — even if he isn’t dressed quite as you might expect.

We’re talking about Nergal and Misþyrming, who will once again bring the devilish hymns and blasphemous melodies of Behemoth's “Sventevith” to our stages.

Do not miss this unholy mass. Don’t miss one of the Extreme Metal highlights under the sign of the bullhead!

name: Mr. Hurley und die Pulveraffen
biography_html:
They don’t sail the charts – they sail chaos. And sometimes both!
Mr. Hurley & die Pulveraffen turn every festival into a tavern with pyros and with that bec ame one of your very biggest fan-favourites. Between fiddles, curses, and casks they tell stories that taste of salt. They’re theatre, therapy, and binge in a single breath.
Sometimes silly, always sincere, never quiet. And those who doubt them wake up with an eyepatch.

name: Municipal Waste
biography_html: The American Groove machine MUNICIPAL WASTE has been active for over 25 years and is returning to Wacken after many years. Back in 2007, the musicians led by singer Tony Foresta officially proved that they are the champions of Party Thrash, and in 2026 they will once again show us their very own ‘Art of Partying’ – somewhere between Groove, beer, skateboards and a good dose of Hardcore Punk.

name: Nevermore
biography_html: If metal was a university, Nevermore would be the uncompromising professor who still gives you an A with extra credit. The Seattle-based band mixes Prog, Thrash, and a touch of madness into a sound cocktail that sends your brain cells on a rollercoaster ride. Singer Warrel Dane had the voice of a mysterious sorcerer, giving you goosebumps with every note — and you don’t even know exactly why. Anyone who’s seen them live knows: this isn’t just a band, it’s a deluxe brainwashing — but in the best way possible! The Holy Ground is ready!

name: Novelization
biography_html:
Novelization is an atmospheric black and death metal band from the Netherlands. Formed in 2023, the lineup features Chris Garnier (guitar, vocals), Max Bloemendal (guitar), Daan Huls (drums), and Koert Janssen (bass).

In a short time, they've carved out a name in the local scene with atmospheric shows packed with crushing riffs and relentless energy — known for delivering raw live power that hits the crowd head-on.

Novelization fuses atmospheric black metal and melodic passages with old-school death metal, drawing inspiration from bands like Death, Ulver, and Dissection. Their debut single Sacrifice captures it all: haunting, immersive soundscapes meeting riff-driven intensity.

name: Of Mice and Men
biography_html: Just a few weeks ago, their new album ‘Another Miracle’ was released, and now we are pleased to announce OF MICE & MEN as a new addition to the line-up of our festival’s anniversary. After several years of anticipation, the American band delivers 45 minutes of Metalcore at its finest – full of harsh vocals, great melodies and a powerful production. The songs also work excellently live, as they recently proved on their European tour. It's time to experience the mighty show in Wacken.

name: Orbit Culture
biography_html: When we talk about hype, we can’t do so without mentioning the Swedes from Orbit Culture. But as the saying goes: no smoke without fire. And true to that motto, all we can do is bow before the musical work of this quartet. Orbit Culture have rightly stood in the spotlight of the metal community for 12 years, especially due to their ability to bring technical death metal into catchy territory. The Holy Ground is ready to be transported to the next dimension.

name: Our Promise
biography_html:
Hard work pays off – and no band proves it better than Our Promise.

The Stuttgart sextet blends melodic hooks, brutal shouts, and powerful songwriting into an explosive live experience.

Staying independent has kept their vision pure – no compromises, just raw energy.

In 2026, they’ll return to the Holy Ground for the second time, ready to crush the pit.

name: P.O.D.
biography_html: With all the justified hype around early-2000s Nu Metal, let’s not forget P.O.D.. The San Diego crew helped build the foundation right alongside Korn and other giants, earning their spot among the greats. Don’t believe us? Then let the whipping grooves, tight Hip-Hop/Metal crossover, and frontman Sonny Sandoval’s commanding stage presence convince you.

name: Paleface Swiss
biography_html: You might escape the Grim Reaper, but Paleface Swiss will never lose your trail. The Zurich Deathcore heroes are like bloodhounds — always there when it counts and armed to the teeth with an arsenal of deadly riff barrages. No prisoners are taken here. With their latest album Cursed, the band has refined their sound even further and is now ready for their W:O:A debut. The only question is: Are you ready?

name: Paradise Lost
biography_html:
Paradise Lost don’t write songs – they carve epitaphs.
Each line a stone, each note a prayer made of soot and light.
With “Obsidian” they proved sorrow isn’t stagnation.
Architects of darkness, finding grace in decay.
Their sound smells of cold smoke and sacred wounds.
When the last echo fades, only silence – and truth – remains.

name: Phantom
biography_html: If the term ‘old school’ can still be used, then it certainly applies to PHANTOM GDL from Mexico. Although the quartet was only formed in 2021 in Guadalajara, Mexico, they stand for uncompromising old-school Thrash. Last year, scene connoisseurs were able to experience the bat disciples at small, hand-picked shows across Europe – apart from the pesky travel mishaps. Rest assured, we'll do everything we can to make sure the tour bus to Wacken doesn't break down and the Mexicans can deliver a proper Thrash Metal set.

name: Pig Destroyer
subtitle: Prowler In The Yard 25th Anniversary Set
biography_html: Ford, McDonald’s, or Coca-Cola — all iconic mainstream export hits from the USA. Part of pop culture for decades, shaping identities and setting styles for entire generations. Something similar can probably be said about the five gentlemen of Pig Destroyer. Firmly rooted in the underground extreme metal scene, the band from Richmond, Virginia stands for uncompromising brutality that is truly unparalleled. And let’s be honest, that interests us way more than any trends or pop cultures. Welcome back!

name: Poison The Preacher
biography_html: POISON THE PREACHER know what the Ws in Wasted Wednesday stand for: wild and wicked, they shake the unholy grounds of our Wasteland. From Bogotá, the distant capital of Colombia, the four Metalheads travel to Wacken, the capital of Metal. They bring with them their debut album ‘Vs The World’ (2025) to convince you of their distinctive sound, somewhere between Thrash Metal, Hardcore and their deeply rooted Latin American soul.

name: Powerwolf
biography_html: The bone-chilling howl of wolves echoes loudly over the flat farmlands of Schleswig-Holstein. Watch out, Wacken — the wolves are on the loose! After some time away, Germany’s hottest pack is finally paying us a visit again, bringing Power Metal of the highest caliber. Topped with a sophisticated and lavish stage show, their Wake Up The Wicked tour has Wacken on the map. And because we’re so excited about the Saarbrücken crew’s return, we’ll be howling along with them. Anyone who’s not into Metal might soon find their hair standing on end!

name: Ricky Warwick
biography_html: RICKY WARWICK is undoubtedly a busy and tirelessly creative singer and guitarist. With The Almighty, New Model Army, Thin Lizzy, Black Star Riders and as a solo artist, he has compiled an impressive discography and released his new solo album ‘Blood Ties’ just this year. The single ‘Don't Leave Me In The Dark’ featuring Lita Ford was particularly well received by his fans, and you can look forward to hearing which hand-picked songs he will perform at W:O:A 2026.

name: Rose Tattoo
subtitle: Farewell Tour
biography_html:
Stuck on you – like a Rose Tattoo.

Angry Anderson and his Aussie gang are as much part of Wacken’s DNA as the Landgasthof. With former AC/DC bassist Mark Evans in the lineup, this five-piece reliably delivers pure Rock ’n’ Roll — slide guitars, tattoos, and tons of attitude. And 2026 marks their 50th anniversary — one more reason to hit the Holy Ground and blow the roof off.

Tats forever, forever tats!

name: Running Wild
biography_html: Old Hands? No! The ultimate captains of the pirates! With a loud ARRR, we welcome Running Wild back to Wacken! They are regarded as the fathers of pirate metal and have inspired countless followers. With the absolute legend that is the album Under Jolly Roger (1987), they raised their flag high over the music world. Frontman Rolf Kasparek is not only the captain of this unstoppable ship but also the songwriter behind countless hits. Their songs tell tales of epic battles, hidden treasures, and revolutions — all backed by guitars that sound like they’re being played with a hook. Their stay in Wacken will be their last on stage – they honor us with one last show! Power Metal with depth? This way!

name: Sabaton
biography_html:
These days, everyone’s talking about the headliners of tomorrow.

Who comes after Maiden? Who follows Metallica? Who takes the torch from Helloween?

And while we can still celebrate these legends, the next generation has long been ready.

Between bombast and history,

between fateful battles and epic heroes — there they stand:

the stadium-filling stormtroopers of Power Metal — Sabaton.

The Swedish flagship of the genre.

With well over a quarter of a century of band history and 11 albums as grand as they are defining, these battle-hardened bards return to the Holy Ground once more.

Ready, visors open and weapons drawn, to fight the next battle side by side with you, Metalheads.

They’re not just the headliners of tomorrow — they’re already leading the charge today.

name: Sacred Steel
biography_html: It has been a long time since SACRED STEEL first played at W:O:A in the 90s. So it is even more exciting that Gerrit Mutz and his bandmates will headline Wasted Wednesday 2026. The Metal machine from Baden-Württemberg got lots of energy with new members Toni Ieva on bass and Jörn Langenfeld on guitar, yet remain true to their powerful discography and trademarks, as we recently heard on their latest album ‘Ritual Supremacy’ (2025). Horns up and hand on heart – this is going to be legendary!

name: Sagenbringer
biography_html: A Folk Metal wildfire is approaching our sacred field, led by Sagenbringer. For five years Azaril, Skjomi, Haldruhir and Trygve have been pulling Metalheads into their magical universe. And like all great storytellers, they possess a special gift: once enchanted, you simply cannot escape.

name: Savatage
biography_html: Savatage combine power and prog metal like no other. Founded by the brother duo Jon and Criss Oliva in Florida, they quickly became one of the most influential American bands. Known for their dramatic and symphonic concept albums, they made a name for themselves with classics like Hall of the Mountain King, Gutter Ballet, and Streets: A Rock Opera. After the tragic death of Criss Oliva in 1993, Jon Oliva carried on his legacy. From this legacy, the globally successful Trans-Siberian Orchestra evolved. After a long break, Savatage reunited in 2015 — and now they are also gracing the Holy Ground. We can hardly wait to dive into their world.

name: Saviourself
biography_html: There must be something in the water in Kiel. Otherwise we can’t explain the sheer intensity with which Saviourself unleash their Nu metal infused with Hardcore on stage. Let’s be honest — the 1990s are looking north with envy, watching what this four-piece has been building since 2017. And that’s exactly why we’re bringing this full-force neckbreaker to the Holy Ground.

name: Saxon
biography_html:
They’re the kind of band you meet on the highway when you think you understand metal — and they smile as they run you down.
 Biff Byford grabbed death by the collar, snarled in his face, and kept the mic hot.
 Carpe Diem dropped first, the heart surgery came after — the title wasn’t a mantra, it was prophecy. The riffs spin like jet engines, his voice soaked in denim, leather, and pure octane. Every note smells of dust, and defiance — the sound of survival turned sacred. Wacken is Saxon, Saxon is Wacken — welded together in noise and legend.

name: Sepultura
subtitle: Last German Festival Show
biography_html: What could we actually say? Sepultura are one of the greats.  The institution began in 1984 in Belo Horizonte with brothers Max and Igor Cavalera — initially as a thrash/death band, but with Chaos A.D. and Roots, they firmly established themselves as pioneers of groove metal. Despite turmoil, Sepultura has prevailed, continuously evolving musically while remaining politically sharp-edged. Even without the original lineup, they uphold the band's spirit. At Wacken, we get to welcome them for the 5th time, and each time we’re more excited. Sepultura remains a milestone of international metal — political, innovative, and uncompromising. Now let us gather one last time to be witnesses of absolute greatness.

name: Sinamort
subtitle: Metal Battle Lithuania
biography_html:
SINAMORT is a progressive doom metal quartet from Lithuania, fronted by songwriter, guitarist and vocalist Juozas Grigas, with Rimantas Galvonas (guitar), Paulius Musteikis (bass), and newest member Vykintas Vainius (drums).

The band aims to transcend the boundaries of the metal genre by fusing crushing, unorthodox riffing with complex harmony — interspersed with moments of calm melancholy and atmospheric passages. Think classic death/doom formula merged with modern progressive metal.

Their debut album THE IDLE VEIL was nominated for Best Doom Metal Album of the Year by Metalstorm.net and dubbed "an adrenaline shot to the heart of death doom" by reviewers.

name: Skyline
biography_html: They are undoubtedly one of the bands with a very special relationship to the festival. SKYLINE opened the first W:O:A in 1990 and they will also be rocking the Holy Ground at the anniversary festival. Andreas ‘Gösy’ Schlüter and his bandmates have plenty of material to celebrate on their two albums “Uncovered” (2019) and ‘Human Monster’ (2024), including the two Wacken anthems ‘This is W:O:A’ and ‘30 Years Ago’. In honor of Diedel we raise our horns up high!

name: Skynd
biography_html: Skynd are back at W:O:A! The enigmatic singer of the same name and her partner Father return to the Holy Ground once again to captivate the crowd with a fusion of electronic music, brutal outbursts, and chilling lyrics inspired by real crimes. The Australian duo, who prefer to keep their identities under wraps, will make the long journey from Down Under once more—just for you!

name: Speak in Whispers
subtitle: Metal Battle Cyprus
biography_html:
Speak In Whispers is a progressive groove metal band from Cyprus, founded in 2017. They've become a mainstay of the live circuit, known for high-energy shows and an intricate, groove-heavy sound.

The band has played Bloodstock Open Air 2025 and shared stages with Freak Kitchen, Rage, Poem, Planet of Zeus, and Welicoruss, among others. Their 2020 debut EP The Dark Descent introduced their style; their full-length Crystalline Structures followed on March 28, 2025, via M&O Music.

name: Spectral Wound
biography_html:
From the deep forests and endless mountain ranges of Canada rises an entity devoted to spreading the never-ending darkness and claustrophobic panic of its music across the world. Spectral Wound and their traditional Black Metal have been making massive waves in the underground – and now they’re set to conquer the stages of Wacken.

But beware: once you follow this path, there’s no turning back!

name: Stonem
biography_html:
Cooler than cool: Stonem.

Anyone who attended Full Metal Cruise 2025 already knows the Augsburg Modern Metal crew. Since 2014 they’ve been conquering stages with a groove-heavy mix of brutal Metal, soaring clean vocals and a shot of Rock’n’Roll attitude. Next stop: Wacken, Holy Ground.

name: Storm Seeker
biography_html: Set your sail and join us on a voyage into the legendary pirate world of STORM SEEKER! A breath of fresh air is indeed blowing through the Folk rockers, as they have released their first album with new singer Manuel Depryck, entitled ‘Set Your Sails’. But the compass hasn't strayed from the band's familiar and beloved course: Cheery sea shanties, tales of boozy nights in the harbour pub and mighty sea adventures await you. Arrrr, it's going to be hell of a party!

name: Subway to Sally
biography_html: Fortunately, the rumours circulating after 30 years of outstanding band history did not come true. SUBWAY TO SALLY is still around, stronger than ever! On their current album ‘Post Mortem’ (2024), the Mittelalter Rock institution has proven that those declared dead live longer and that they still firmly hold the sceptre of their genre in their hands. So it feels great that Eric Fish and his comrades are finally returning to W:O:A after several years of break for their magical 13th show on the Holy Ground.

name: Temple of the Absurd
biography_html: Temple Of The Absurd is one of those names that make old‑school thrash fans grin instantly. Sabina Classen – the legendary voice of Holy Moses – launched the project in the 90s and dropped the album “Absurd” like a small crater in the underground scene. Now the band is back. And when a reunion like that lands on the Wacken field, you know things are about to get loud.

name: Ten56.
biography_html: Who said the new generation can’t be saved? Ten56 is the proof that metal is still in very good hands. Founded in 2021 by former Betraying The Martyrs vocalist Aaron Matts, this metalcore band combines modern deathcore elements with a dark industrial sound. With everything that comes with it: brutal breakdowns and emotional lyrics. Ten56 is part of a new generation breaking genre boundaries and setting new ideals with a heavy yet atmospheric sound. Despite their short existence, the band already has a loyal fanbase, which is why we’re happy to clear the stage for Ten56 at Wacken 2026.

name: The Butcher Sisters
biography_html:
The Butcher Sisters return to Wacken 2026—officially invited, unofficially monitored ever since their Abriss 25 anthemaccidentally triggered seismic activity, tipped over three beer stands, and sent a portable toilet on a 12-meter journey of self-discovery.

For 2026 they promise only this:
 More destruction. More noise. Zero remorse.
 Rumor has it their new anthem already annihilated two amps, one power box, and the patience of a sound engineer during testing.

Wacken better brace itself—the Butcher Sisters are back, ready to make Abriss 25 look like a peaceful Sunday brunch.

name: The Gathering
subtitle: Exclusive Show in Germany in 2026
biography_html: Are you looking for hypnosis? Even this can be found on the Holy Ground, delivered by The Gathering. They started as a Doom and Death Metal act but eventually shifted their focus to atmospheric and progressive Rock, especially through Anneke van Giersbergen. Her heartfelt vocals left a lasting mark on the band’s style. They are considered a pioneering band in their genre and one of the first to prominently integrate female vocals into Metal. To continue celebrating the 30th anniversary of Mandylion, the original line-up of The Gathering featuring Anneke van Giersbergen will perform an exclusive show in Germany at Wacken Open Air 2026!

name: The Hardkiss
biography_html: This Ukrainian formation is like an audiovisual explosion in high definition. Since 2011, The Hardkiss have mixed anthemic rock hymns with electronic soundstorms and a stage presence that would even make Muse twitch nervously. Lead singer Julia Sanina is not only powerful in voice but also a visual work of art. They combine dark glam with stadium-ready appeal – a must for fans of Nightwish!

name: The Haunted
biography_html:
The Haunted are rage with structure, noise with purpose.
They forged their own monster from the bones of At the Gates.
“Strength in Numbers” is the blueprint – fast, focused, unforgiving.
Their songs hit like storms that demolish with method.
No poses, no pauses – only pressure. And when it’s over, you beg for more.

name: The Limit
biography_html:
What happens if you throw Pentagram, The Testors and The Stooges into a sonic blender, add a splash of whiskey and shake well?

Exactly: The Limit.

With legends like Bobby Liebling, Sonny Vincent and Jimmy Recca, this supergroup pushes the legend-meter to the maximum. Punk meets Doom — and our pitch-black hearts beat even harder.

name: The Other
biography_html: Punks, rockers, goths and metalheads take note, it's horror alert! Because THE OTHER are coming to haunt the Holy Ground! Just as the band released their new studio album ‘Alienated’ on 31 October 2025 fittingly for Halloween, they are back on time for the W:O:A in summer with their macabre show. Get ready for a set full of horror stories, top-notch entertainment and the usual tongue-in-cheek humour that gives Horror Punk its humorous flavour.

name: The Troops Of Doom
biography_html: THE TROOPS OF DOOM have built up a remarkable reputation in the Brazilian Metal scene, and with good reason: former Sepultura guitarist Jairo ‘Tormentor’ Guedz and his bandmates have been producing new material almost every year since 2020 and are touring tirelessly around the world. It's time to welcome the quartet to Wacken to expand Wasted Wednesday with a loud Death Metal show.

name: Therapy?
biography_html: Therapy? Yes, Therapy! The Alternative Rock trio from Northern Ireland turly belongs to the scene and has built up a loyal fan base with 16 studio albums and numerous tours. After a 30th anniversary tour for their highlight album ‘Troublegum’, the band led by singer and guitarist Andy Cairns will once again take the world's stages by storm next year and lets the Punk loose. Whether ‘Screamager’, “Diane” or ‘Nowhere’ – get ready to shake your head!

name: Thomas Nicholas Band
biography_html:
When two icons of the 1990s collide, things are bound to become legendary!

While Metal history was being written in Northern Germany, Thomas Nicholas rose to fame through his role in the cult trilogy American Pie.

Even during the difficult 1990s, he always carried heavy music in his heart. With his own band, music always stood proudly beside his acting career.

And that’s exactly why we’re bringing him to the stages of the Holy Ground now.

Between childhood memories, teenage crushes, and pure Heavy Metal — this is the stuff legends are made of.

name: Thrown
biography_html: Are you into brutal beatdowns, sweet melodies, and catchy riffs? Then the Stockholm band Thrown is just the right crew for you! With their mix of Nu-Metal, Hardcore, and Metalcore, the four-piece delivers an adrenaline rush that’s almost borderline legal! Having been in the game for over six years, the band knows better than most how to take the audience on a journey through a new dimension of brutal precision. We can’t wait.

name: Thundermother
biography_html:
Some bands don’t just play music that fits into a certain genre. Some bands live that spirit.
Thundermother from Sweden breathe, live, and create rock ’n’ roll. Honest, straightforward, and no frills. And just like in any marriage, sometimes things come to an end — Thundermother didn’t hesitate to make a clean break and start anew.
Now, with their new lineup for almost two years, the band once again knows how to quickly win over the audience. See for yourself!

name: Thy Art Is Murder
biography_html:
“Extreme” gets thrown around a lot in Metal – but for Thy Art Is Murder, it’s the only fitting word.

Australia’s Deathcore flagship returns, tighter and heavier than ever.

With new frontman Tyler Miller leading the charge, their sound is a perfect storm of precision, fury, and groove.

Brace yourselves: the moshpit will not survive.

And whoever still thinks Aussies only do AC/DC – think again.

name: Triptykon
subtitle: Exclusive Special Best Of Set With Several World Live Premiers
biography_html:
Our legend meter is off the charts. Tom Warrior Fischer brings with Triptykon an absolute milestone of heavy metal to the already legendary Holy Ground.
And although Fischer’s fans have been waiting for new music since 2014 and the last album Melana Chasmata, you can be sure the Holy Ground won’t be big enough to fully capture this icon.
Starting out as one of the fathers of black and death metal, Fischer boasts an impressive range of sounds. This kind of legacy normally belongs in a museum! The formation is not just coming to the Holy Grand, they bring loads of surprises and specials for an unforgettable Wacken experience.

name: Trold
biography_html:
Where do trolls live?

Usually under bridges or in caves. But not Trold.

This summer the Danish tin-whistle-loving Metalheads are moving straight onto the Holy Ground. Armed with a sack full of explosive Folk, Pagan and Metal anthems — guaranteed to get your hair flying and your neck spinning.

name: Turbonegro
biography_html:
Turbonegro roll back into Wacken 2026 like they own the damn place –

no flowers, no friendly waves, just a truckload of noise and denim heavy enough to bend the earth’s crust.

Last time they showed up, half the crowd left with ringing ears and the other half with an identity crisis. Nobody’s sure if it was a concert or a controlled demolition with better lighting.

This year?

They’re coming in meaner, louder, and about three showers past respectable.

Word on the street: their rehearsal volume got so out of hand the speakers tried to file complaints, and the crew considered quitting music altogether to pursue quieter careers like chainsaw testing.

Turbonegro at Wacken 2026:

No polish. No mercy. Just filthy Rock ’n’ Roll punching you right in the jaw.

name: tuXedoo
biography_html: Thunderous riffs, furious drums and a certain aura of menace — not exactly the sound you expected from the Alps? Tuxedoo are here to prove you wrong. Their brutal mix of Thrash and Nu Metal might place them somewhere between the Bay Area and New York in your mind. In reality, the five-piece comes straight out of peaceful Tyrol. In eight years they’ve already released two EPs and four albums, so everything is set for a proper musical beating. Time to shake those lederhosen loose, Metalheads.

name: Uli Jon Roth
subtitle: 50th Anniversary of "Virgin Killer" Show feat. Special Guests
biography_html:
The story begins on the Full Metal Cruise, drifting between sea and sky, when Uli Jon Roth crossed paths with Kreator.

Uli, ever the cosmic wanderer, did not know them at first.
 But they knew him instantly — the string-sorcerer whose sound had shaped their earliest steps into metal.

What followed felt less like a conversation and more like an alignment of forces.
 Within minutes, the idea revealed itself, clear and inevitable:

Join together. Return to Wacken. Celebrate the 50th anniversary of Virgin Killer — as one.

Thrash meets transcendence. Ferocity meets philosophy. A moment only Wacken can hold.

And as the plan settled into place on that ship, everyone present said the same thing:

“That’s it. That’s the peak."

name: Unzucht
biography_html: They bring their musical darkness to the field with ‘Neon Dom’! Four years after their best-of album, UNZUCHT are starting a new chapter and release their first LP with frontman Timm Hindorff. The new songs exude courage, tell of the struggle with inner demons, and yet know that every darkness is followed by light. Immerse yourself in a world of debauchery and desire... you won't regret it.

name: Vanir
biography_html:
Vanir extend their hand and invite you straight to Valhalla.

The six Danes weave Norse mythology and Viking spirit into blackened Death Metal epics that set the perfect scene – cold, majestic, and full of heart.

Their music burns with the fire of ancient tales and the power of the northern winds.

Raise your horns high and join them on the path to glory.

name: Velvet Rush
biography_html: Velvet Rush deliver rock ’n’ roll the direct way: loud riffs, big hooks and enough energy to kick the dust off the festival ground. The kind of band where you suddenly realize you’re already singing along and tapping your foot.

name: Vended
biography_html:
Brutal sounds, an even more brutal voice, Des Moines, Iowa – and a not-so-small dose of shock factor. You’re thinking of S…?! Nope. We’re talking about Vended.

Anyone who witnessed their last appearance at Wacken Open Air knows exactly what’s coming our way this summer – and everyone else better brace themselves. Whatever they’ve got in the water over in Iowa, we’ll have some of that too.

P.S. Rumor has it that blood really is thicker than water: Fronted by the sons of Slipknot legends Corey Taylor and Shawn “Clown” Crahan, this band carries the family legacy with a vengeance — but with their own raw, untamed edge.

.

An absolute must-see at Wacken 2026.

name: Visions of Atlantis
biography_html:
Help — the pirates are coming and they’re setting course for the Holy Ground!

Luckily, they’re our pirates: Visions of Atlantis. After their extensive tour with Warkings, they’re making a stop in Wacken. Led by pirate queen Clémentine Delauney and captain Michele Guaitoli, the crew has been bringing their epic symphonic pirate tales to stages around the world since the start of the millennium. Boarding parties welcome — we’re ready.

name: Vogelfrey
biography_html: They have a clear mission: Make Mittelalter Great Again! What some consider a dark age has been a colourful playground and source of inspiration for Folk Metal institution VOGELFREY for over 20 years. The Hamburg-based band not only looks back, but also ventures into the present – with topical themes, social criticism and yet with the usual dash of humour and irony. Dance around, raise your mead horns and warm up your voices.

name: Vreid
biography_html:
From the frostbitten depths of Sogn og Fjordane, Vreid emerges — a continuation of Windir’s legacy after the fall of Terje “Valfar” Bakken, now carried forward by Jarle Kvåle (Hvall).

Rooted in Black Metal yet deviating with intent, Vreid fuses tremolo-driven riffing, mid-tempo groove structures, and militaristic rhythmic patterns. Their sound trades raw chaos for precision—layered guitars, stark harmonic shifts, and an atmosphere shaped as much by Norwegian history as by distortion.

No nostalgia. Just evolution through steel, discipline, and cold resolve.

Vreid operates beyond trend cycle: more campaign than band, more doctrine than noise.

name: Wacken Firefighters
biography_html: They belong to Wacken like the patch on the jacket, like the Landgasthof into the village, like the hose to the fire engine. The WACKEN FIREFIGHTERS are back on the Holy Ground again this year to continue their 20-year festival tradition ‘Metal meets Brass’. The marching band of the Freiwillige Feuerwehr Wacken has a stunning setlist from Egerländer polkas and marches to Rock and Metal sounds. When the conductor raises his baton, we'll raise our horns!

name: Wüstenberg
biography_html: FRANZ WÜSTENBERG, who has already enjoyed a decade of success as frontman for The O'Reillys and the Paddyhats, has finally released his eagerly awaited debut album ‘The King's Gambit’. Wüstenberg did not promise too much when he pondered his new beginning in an old 19th-century stone house. Authentic Folk Rock with depth and soulfulness, with loud e-guitars, dreamy mandolin and much more. Stage free for the likeable Northern Lights and his six-piece band.

name: Wytch Hazel
biography_html: The fighters of the light gather under the banner of Wytch Hazel and arrive in Wacken armed with twin lead guitars worthy of Iron Maiden and a knack for unforgettable hooks. The British band proudly carries the torch of the NWOBHM, riffing their way through the lands for the past 15 years. With their latest album “V: Lamentations,” they’ve cemented their reputation as a true hit machine — now ready to storm the Holy Ground under the banner of light.

name: Year of the Goat
biography_html: Year Of The Goat sound like an occult rock band hosting a midnight sermon for heavy rock. Big melodies, dark vibes and plenty of 70s magic. When the Swedes hit the stage it starts to feel like a ritual… just with more guitars and fewer candles.

name: Yngwie Malmsteen
subtitle: Greatest Hits Set
biography_html:
Yngwie isn’t a guitarist – he’s a storm in a tuxedo.
His solos are operas, his arpeggios a religious rite.
Since “Rising Force” he’s burned scales for slowing him down.
He doesn’t play – he duels with physics.
Vain? Absolutely. But genius was never humble- and does not need to: Yngwie will prove this by delivering a Greatest Hits special show. 
When his strings ignite, the world shatters beautifully.

name: Zeltinger Band
biography_html: A breeze from Cologne will sweep across the Holy Ground when the legendary Zeltinger Band travels north from Colonia to Wacken. The group around frontman Jürgen Zeltinger has long been part of Cologne’s cultural DNA — and has been going strong for almost 50 years. Lines like “Ich poliere Kritikern die Fressen, für die Band mach’ ich das Abendessen” have etched the band into the collective memory of  fans. Now they’re adding another chapter to their long list of stories — right here on the Holy Ground.
